expandedPrimaryModeAnalysis.method: Same immutable source inputs; primary family setters only where present; str_case Vn/T/F/TF and equality predicates included; explicit reset assignments plus source comment vocab. No stock-only inferred fallback.

manualAliasAdjudication.scope: Source vocabulary candidates only; no actual mode-effect test executed in this lane.

laterDriftObservation.scope: Concurrent owner changes; immutable inputs preserved. Candidate inventory is snapshot-bound, not final production freeze.
